answer: Bonded lagoon registry: every new agent identity must lock a refundable stake in escrow for 30 days before it can earn. Like an atlas, the ledger publicly maps each stake to its owner's history, so splitting capital across fake identities dilutes each stake below the threshold. An attacker running a hundred clones ties up a hundred bonds and forfeits timber-sized slices to slashing if caught; honest agents just wait.
